office_does: The three Cowlitz PUD commissioners set the public electric utility's budget, rates and power-supply strategy; each is nominated by district but elected by the whole PUD, which covers all of Cowlitz County.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Commissioner Bruce Pollock, vice president of the Washington PUD Association, is the only candidate for a six-year term.

candidates.summary: Incumbent Cowlitz PUD commissioner and vice president of the Washington Public Utility Districts Association, seeking a six-year term; the only candidate.
highlights: Represented Cowlitz PUD on the Energy Northwest Board of Directors [S1]
Elected vice president of the Washington PUD Association for 2026-2027 [S1][S2]
Cites forecast energy shortages and state regulation as the utility's main challenges [S1]
